g.text: Tools change mid-run, the plan doesn't, and the Hotel agent holds the room instead of booking it.
· addresses are hardcoded, in code or in config
· routes are worked out in advance
A stale name or address fails with an error,
Fix: resolve names when you call (service discovery),
cache them only for their TTL; on failure, resolve again.
step-2 done, no room booked: H-001 lapses
(1) the orchestrator's runtime runs step-2 as written
(2) the plan names the tools of turn 1
(3) the model calls the closest tool: HoldHotel
Fix: before each step, check its tools against the agent's
current ones; if they changed, plan again.
